text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. I managed to run properly, 
without any issues.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, yes...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: I am fine now.

Through this Kobe Shimbun Hai, it seemed 
she became certain the answer she found at 
summer camp was the right one.

Now that she's taken a step forward, I 
want to put together her upcoming race 
rotation right away.

"Our next race was planned to be the 
Kikuka Sho, which we had set our sights on 
before. Just as I opened my mouth to bring 
it up—"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: —Um, so, I have a favor to ask.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"During today's race... I kept chanting in 
my head like an incantation, 'I'm fine 
just the way I am.'"

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
"Driven by those feelings, I ran, took the 
lead, and the view I saw from there... was 
truly breathtaking."

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Looking at that scenery made me realize 
something.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
If I run with even faster girls... and 
manage to take the lead, ...I wonder what 
kind of amazing view I'll get to see.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: ... That's why...

Silence Suzuka looked up with a look of 
quiet determination on her face.

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
That's why I... want to run in the Tenno 
Sho (Autumn) someday...!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
I just had a feeling that if it's there, 
I'd get to see something incredible...!

The Tenno Sho (Autumn) is the pinnacle of 
middle-distance GⅠ races— It is an 
extremely high-level GⅠ where not only the 
Classic Class, but also Senior Class 
powerhouses compete.

However, I want to cherish a goal born 
from within herself. Besides, with her 
talent and strength at medium distances, 
that grand stage is no mere dream.
—Even so, a bit more experience is needed.
choice_data_list:
Got it, let's make it our big goal for 
next year!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes...!

If our primary goal is the Tenno Sho 
(Autumn), I'd rather set up a more 
suitable rotation than the long-distance 
Kikuka Sho.

It would be best to enter a GII 
medium-distance race that matches the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn)'s distance as closely 
as possible. Which means passing on the 
Kikuka Sho—
choice_data_list: First, why don't we enter the Kinko Sho?
First, how about entering the Kinko Sho?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: "The Kinko Sho, was it? Understood...!"

—And so, as a stepping stone toward the 
Tenno Sho (Autumn), the Kinko Sho became 
our next goal!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of the Tenno Sho (Autumn), I 
have to grow so much more...!

Harboring hope for the grand stage, she 
truly seemed to have grown a great deal.
